scope: Local production web image and real PostgreSQL; public cloud deployment not performed

before.cause: Native SDK counter resets after idle time and refreshes lastRequest on each accepted read

after.algorithm: PostgreSQL atomic GCRA using database time
after.keyStorage: Purpose-separated HMAC of the same trusted SDK network address; no raw IP or cookie
after.cleanup: At most 32 expired other keys per read; SKIP LOCKED; current key excluded; opportunistic

limits: Real multi-replica cloud load and school shared-IP demand remain unverified
Native credential and OTP limits remain separate and unchanged
IP budget is not a global memory, bandwidth or distributed denial-of-service defense
Cleanup is not a hard retention deadline when traffic stops
The migration must precede web rollout; cloud rollout and rollback require later verification
